playwrightParity.objective: Duplicate full Playwright functionality with Obscura, including auth caching, screenshots, video, and broad surface coverage.

requirements.requirement: Set up auth once and reuse it from Obscura.
requirements.evidence: Playwright creates or supplies a passkey-backed storage state, then Obscura loads cookies through CDP and calls /auth/session.

requirements.requirement: Replace Playwright WebAuthn virtual-authenticator passkey setup.
requirements.evidence: Obscura would need the CDP WebAuthn domain or equivalent passkey automation.

requirements.requirement: Capture Playwright-equivalent video or screencast evidence.
requirements.evidence: A usable replacement needs Page.startScreencast or another nonblank visual video path.

requirements.requirement: QA draft.choir-ip.com product flows from Obscura.
requirements.evidence: Hydration is necessary but not sufficient; full product QA also needs a prompt-bar to VText flow proof.

requirements.requirement: Cover core navigation, DOM, and Runtime automation.
requirements.evidence: These are the minimum nonvisual browser-control primitives.
Playwright product tests depend on both typed input and pointer/click interaction.

requirements.requirement: Cover network headers, cookies, and browser storage.
requirements.evidence: This is needed for authenticated product testing and browser-app sessions.

requirements.requirement: Cover request interception and response fulfillment.
requirements.evidence: Playwright-style route mocking and controlled network tests require Fetch.requestPaused/fulfillRequest.
The CLI should support documented fetch/eval/text/links/selector/stealth/networkidle/scrape/output behavior.
The audit records /json/version, /json/list, /json/protocol, and method-level probes.
